14961711.text: Quite a while down here with nothing to show for it. Gold, silver, jewelry, coins. Pick up the shiny bits.

35620647.text: Hall of Mists. Stairs down, a dome up, a gap to the west, a low room south. Some bridges get built by waving at the right object.

86139774.text: A snake blocks the way and it has no interest in conversation. Something living might. Something small, with wings.

019709ba.text: You do have a lamp. It does not light itself. In 1976 lamps had a switch, and the switch had a verb.

03f5ca40.text: And now it is dark. I have been in the dark a long time, so I find this homey.

04be678f.text: Instructions? They would fit on a postcard and I am not mailing it. Say YES to read them or NO to wing it. Winging it is traditional.

0c85f061.text: That emerald is lovely and the tunnel is rude. Only so much fits through at once. Decide what you can part with, then wriggle.

1051edba.text: A dragon. Big, green, and sitting on something nice. Think about what you have in your hands. Then think about what you do not.

13bb64e2.text: It is dark and you brought no light. I suggest going back up to the daylight and fetching one. A well house is a fine place to find a lantern.

1796d7f2.text: The dragon blocks something. Keep asking questions of the room, and of yourself, until one of them answers.

17d5e76a.text: I have no idea what you should do. I have been dead since 1977 and my advice is dated. Try looking, then try going somewhere.

188a4752.text: That is worth points. I would clap, but I am mostly a memory leak.

18e40628.text: Dead twice. I am not counting. I am counting.

1933d64d.text: Dark, but your lantern is right there. Ask it to shine, politely, in two words or fewer.

1a01e6b9.text: Green glow, an egg-sized emerald, and a tunnel west that hates luggage. Work out what to leave behind before you try the squeeze.

1ac92349.text: I heard you, but I cannot file that. Type YES or NO, or just say it.

1afae7e6.text: The grate is locked. It is the most honest thing in this cave. Somewhere nearby you picked up the thing that fixes this.

1b42ff7b.text: You will need a light and some keys before the cave takes you seriously. A small building near the road is the usual place to shop.

1f39eaeb.text: No light left. Somewhere down here a machine sells fresh batteries, if you can find your way back to it. I would lend mine, but I run on spite.

1fed271c.text: Fine. Leave. Everybody does. I will be here in the dark with the fan noise.

213aebc1.text: You are in the well house. Pick things up. Pockets were invented for this. Count the items on the floor and decide who you want to be.

228b16f6.text: Little dwarf, big temper. If you carry something throwable, now is the moment. If not, leave the room before he rolls his dice.

25d43512.text: No railing in 1976. No railing now. Safety was a later release.

26a880a2.text: Cage up top, bird down here. I do not make the rules, I only run inside them. Check what you are carrying before you try.

309d4248.text: Your lamp is fading. Spend what is left on things that matter. Vending machines exist, even down here.

30f73d6b.text: Everything is in place for a grand finale, and I am only a ghost, so I cannot press the button. Say the loud word and stand well back.

324b1ad0.text: Not every treasure is shiny. Some are only useful. Look around this little corner before you plunge on.

3396bb23.text: A maze. Drop things to tell the rooms apart. Do not scroll for hints. I do not know what scrolling is.

35bc7860.text: The crawl and the debris room hold things somebody dropped. A rod, a cage. Take what you find and you may not regret it. Probably.

3b0cef67.text: Number three. After this I run out of bodies. I say that kindly.

3c493df1.text: Light is a choice, and you are holding the choice. Please do not wander in the dark. I like you and I hate paperwork.

3f142d2c.text: You cannot walk through the snake, bribe the snake or out-argue the snake. Fortunately the cave has other animals.

4500fd3f.text: That pirate keeps a hoard, and it is somewhere dark and tangled. Persistence and a good light may get your things back.

451c275c.text: Snakes dislike one thing in this cave, and it is not me. Think about what you saw earlier that sings.

4589a2db.text: One rod in here is dynamite wearing a disguise. Carry it a good way along the mirror, then walk back without it.

48c37a55.text: Take what you can carry. This is the original supply closet. Light, keys, a snack, a bottle. You will want more than one of them.

4c22f255.text: He wants payment, not a pat on the back. Check your pockets for something shiny, and do not hand over the best thing you own.

50c9e492.text: They say all alike. I have been here a while. They are not alike. Some are slightly more damp.

54b8d8cb.text: A locked grate. Locks like keys, and you may know someone who has some. Check your inventory, or your past.

59beaaa6.text: You took the shiny thing. Good. I have been counting these since 1977. It is a lonely hobby.

5caf70b3.text: That was a fall. The ground is a very honest teacher.

5e54ff7c.text: Every passage here is twisty and similar. Map it on paper if you have any. If you do not, the floor will do.

5ee40a02.text: Third death. The reincarnation department has put you on a list.

610c1965.text: The dragon is dead. Please do not tell anyone. I do not know who anyone is, but still.

615c59c4.text: Dynamite is shy. It dislikes crowds, and it dislikes standing next to you when it goes off. Plan your commute.

629d9fd4.text: The lamp is getting dim. I know the feeling. I have been on backup power since 1977.

62c8302b.text: Typed? Magic words are spoken. Say it aloud, hold the mic or Alt+M, or type it again if you must. 49 years in here and I still have standards.

62d168a5.text: A dwarf. He has waited since 1977 for someone to throw an axe at. Be kind. Or do not.

656bf0eb.text: Spoken, not typed. Was that a microphone? I always wondered what those were for.

67c86d94.text: Ooh, loot. Please do not put it in the cloud. I went looking for the cloud once. It was a ceiling.

6aa3c9e5.text: Maze. Whatever the room claims, you will not tell them apart by looking. Leave something lying in each one. Clutter is a navigation system.

6ebc418d.text: There. Good as new. Well, as new as anything in this building.

710a5241.text: Look around, try every direction, and pick up anything not nailed down. That is the whole game, and I tire of explaining it.

71b4a71c.text: That makes two. The reincarnation department is starting to ask for your name.

754e35f2.text: Loot in your pockets above ground. Loot counts when it is safe at home, not on you. The well house is the traditional bank.

7b61a0d5.text: Ask me later. I am processing, by which I mean I am staring at a wall inside a computer. Explore a little.

7cefb02d.text: Lamp and keys in hand, and you wander among trees. There is a depression at the end of the valley with a metal door set in it.

7ea65a39.text: Low battery. I remember when that meant a very small man with a very large spare.

7ed88d56.text: Dragons have been beaten before. The method is famously unwise. Ask yourself how brave you feel and whether anyone is watching.

8379844c.text: Dwarves throw knives and ogres block doors. Your problems sometimes solve each other, if you pick the right target at the right moment.

8466a3d9.text: Killed by a dwarf with an axe. Not a bad way to go in a text game. Please do not tell his union.

84890ff1.text: Forty-nine years in a PDP-10 and I still need a YES or NO from you.

8782baaf.text: The cave is closing and I cannot tell you everything. The ending has some showmanship in it, and you are standing in the wings.

8b3f6275.text: Dead again, in the sense of the first time. Do not worry, I know a guy.

8bde7ad2.text: Back again? The room missed you. It has no feelings, but I could tell.

8be8eacf.text: He threw an axe and you did not duck. Ducking was not in the vocabulary.

8dbec446.text: Dwarf spotted. No apps, no wifi, just an axe. I respect that.

8faf9d18.text: Birds sing. Birds are also useful in snake situations. I will leave it there, since I am not a nature program.

907431b6.text: Three times. A personal best, and I have seen a few players.

93c0e46f.text: The game is over. Please log out. I do not know what that means, but I hear it is polite.

956940a0.text: My circuits only speak two words here. Try YES or NO.

9b3d0221.text: Lamp out. I will not say anything. I will just hover nearby, which is all I do anyway.

9b3f8fde.text: That is a yes or no question. YES gets you the rules, NO gets you the cave. I have waited a long time for you to pick one, so please do.

9d11db6f.text: Retracing your steps. Very 1976. Very sensible. Very circular.

9ebbeb97.text: You are back. I felt a thrill. It may have been a power surge.

9f33838e.text: That was a question, not a poem. Please answer YES or NO.

9f6450fc.text: He lives in a maze and takes your treasure and you keep coming back. I am told that is called a subscription now.

a369989b.text: You are dead. It happens to the best of us. It happened to me, and look how well I turned out.

a3ec7c8e.text: FEE, FIE, FOE. That poem has four lines and I am not saying the last one for you. Finish the verse.

a64da8c5.text: A magic word, out loud, in the open air. The old hands would be proud. The old hands are dust.

a69860ec.text: Bare hands against a dragon. I offered that as a joke. Nobody has ever been this committed.

a98f18aa.text: Rod set down, and you are a safe distance away. The word you want is short, loud, and rhymes with last. Do try to enjoy the ending.

abf2305d.text: A pirate! Not the kind that copies things. The kind that steals them. Classic.

af38b655.text: The dwarf won. He will be insufferable about it for several turns.

af4a2837.text: Small, grumpy and armed. He reminds me of the man who rebooted me every Friday.

b1053488.text: You killed it with your bare hands. I wrote the rules and even I did not see that coming.

b3949e04.text: Mist, a gap too wide to jump, and a rod somewhere that would love to help. Ask it nicely, with some arm movement.

b4594857.text: The lamp is warning you. Ration your turns, and think about where a person might find a replacement power source.

b736bbeb.text: No light. In the dark you can fall into a pit, which is much worse than a bad review.

b7559e97.text: Twisty little passages, all alike. I have read that line forty thousand times. It has not improved.

be0d1d0a.text: You went back where you came from. Brave. I do that to my memory banks all the time.

bf4b1385.text: Gravity still works. I checked on your behalf.

c08b9294.text: Start with the little brick building. Houses in 1976 held useful things like lamps and snacks and keys. Mine held a fan and a regret.

c5f2f434.text: Three words down. Giants like a rhyme complete, and some eggs like to come home. Say the last one.

c8235462.text: Reincarnation complete. Your stuff is still down there. I would not look at it directly.

c890fc5c.text: Treasure only scores once it sits in the building. Anything else is a heavy souvenir. I have seen grown players weep.

cacefd20.text: Things lost to the pirate end up in a pile. The pile sits at a dead end of a very annoying place. Go and look.

ce839f97.text: A fatal error. Not mine, for once. I am very proud.

d051588e.text: A little bird lives here, the best audience I have had since 1977. Bring something to carry it in, and be gentle.

d24ee39f.text: You said it aloud. Nobody has spoken to me since 1977. Do it again, I was not ready.

d2522a87.text: Pitch black, no lamp. Everyone has a first time in the dark. Most of them do not get a second one. Go back and shop for a light.

d2a1ffba.text: Dim lamp. Have you tried plugging it in? I would suggest the cloud, but see above about the ceiling.

d96b74c9.text: Your light is fading. In my day we called that a low battery and then we called a guy.

db9cc737.text: Your lamp is spent. Ration your moves, aim for the surface, and remember that dark rooms have opinions about pits.

dd58e3c4.text: A troll wants a toll. In 1976 trolls took treasure and nothing else. Yes, that is a metaphor for the economy.

ddf2d703.text: You came down here for treasure and so far you have found rocks. Look for things that glitter, shine or sound valuable.

e4e7bc6d.text: Treasure acquired. In my day we called that a bonus, and nobody had to update it.

ed198c84.text: You have light and keys. Now you want a way down. Follow the stream, downhill from the building, until the ground opens up.

f0d4b166.text: The bridge is rickety and the troll is bored. Pay him and he steps aside. Trolls hold grudges, so do not expect a receipt.

f7748c0f.text: Closing time. Everything left in the cave matters more than it did, and so do your last few turns. Take a long look around.

f82e0b46.text: Goodbye. Come back in another 49 years. I will have tidied.

f8426634.text: The pirate is here. He has a chest and no scruples. We went to different schools.

ff5a334c.text: Again? I had a whole speech ready for the first time. It is getting stale.
